CONTROL_BIND_V2.directive: Call get_goal; require same active thread. send_message /root {a,ch,g,k:"bound",n,qh,r,sh,v:2}, hashes from c,q; wait. Mismatch: complete Goal and return.

SUBJECT_ATOM_V2.directive: Call get_goal; require same active thread. Apply c,q to p once. send_message /root {a,g,k:"result",n,r,rh,v:2}; call update_goal complete; send its exact result to /root; return {a,g,k:"task_final",n,status:"SETTLED",v:2}.
